references.text: A young bull as a sin offering for the priest, the same type of offering that Aaron is asked to bring
The sin offering bull was brought forward at the consecration of Aaron and his sons
The ram for the burnt offering was brought forward at the priests' consecration
The requirement that the burnt offering must be without blemish (תָּמִים)
A young bull as a sin offering for the whole congregation
Young bulls and rams without blemish for priestly consecration
Aaron shall enter the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering
The high priest must bring an offering for his own sins, just as Aaron did
The high priests first had to bring an offering for their own sins
